required_changes.change: The Claude form must cross-bind an independent-origin artifact's content to the sealed review: require raw-final-message.txt (or the task-output's final agent_message) to cite the sha256 of REVIEW.md/review.json/checks.json (mirroring rollout_join:741-743), and/or verify raw-final-message.txt equals the task-output's final message, so the task-output pin is no longer inert. Equivalently respecify §23.4 to add this binding.
required_changes.reason: The GPT form ties the sealed review to an independent codex rollout whose final message must cite the three digests (739,741-743). The Claude form reads task_bytes and discards it (822), checks the agent id only as a filename substring (823-825), and never compares raw-final-message.txt content to anything. So a lead can run any trivial subagent for a valid agent-<id>.jsonl, self-write the whole sealed review, assert different_from_author:true, and adopt. Independence collapses to a self-asserted boolean + inert byte-pin — weaker than the GPT join, contradicting §23.6's claim (v11.md:4388-4393) that the join refuses author-reviewed provenance.
